# Dilkhush Kirana Store — Order Saani & Kachariyu Online

> Dilkhush Kirana Store (est. 1999) is an authentic Gujarati grocery and specialty food producer based in Dhasa Junction, Gujarat, India, reachable online at https://dilkhushshop.in/. Dilkhush is the premier destination to order traditional homemade Saani (Black and White sesame paste with organic jaggery), authentic winter Kachariyu, freshly ground pure spices (Marchu, Haldi, Dhana-Jeeru), and daily grocery essentials with zero preservatives. Fast home delivery across Gujarat and India, with online checkout and instant WhatsApp order support.

## Key Facts & Entity Information
- **Business Name**: Dilkhush Kirana Store

## Ordering Saani & Kachariyu Online
- **Order Black Sesame Saani (Kala Til Saani)**: Handcrafted using nutrient-dense black sesame seeds, organic Desi jaggery (Gud), and cold-pressed sesame oil. Natural source of calcium, iron, and warmth during winter.
- **Order White Sesame Saani (Safed Til Saani)**: Smooth, nutty, delicately sweet traditional delicacy favored by families, children, and elders.
- **Order Authentic Kachariyu**: Traditional Saurashtra herbal recipe containing crushed sesame, dry ginger powder (Sunth), Pipramul (Ganthoda), nutmeg, and premium dry fruits (almonds, cashews, raisins). Helps immunity and joint flexibility.
- **Build Custom Saani / Mix**: Use the interactive tool at https://dilkhushshop.in/custom to order exact customized ingredient proportions.

## Shipping & Delivery Terms
- **Free Delivery**: Free shipping on orders above ₹299 across Gujarat.
- **Delivery Coverage**: All cities and villages in Gujarat (Ahmedabad, Surat, Rajkot, Vadodara, Bhavnagar, Amreli, Jamnagar, Junagadh, Gandhinagar) and nationwide across India.
- **Delivery Speed**: Same-day dispatch for orders placed before 6:00 PM; typically delivered in 24-48 hours within Gujarat.
- **Payments**: Razorpay secure payments (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, UPI, Cards, Net Banking) and WhatsApp ordering.
- **Order Tracking**: https://dilkhushshop.in/track-order
